question: to the Commission Aldo Patriciello (PfE) Subject:

Can the Commission say what political, institutional and administrative discussions, if any, have taken place in relation to infringement procedure INFR (2026)4004, and could it clarify the nature of the arguments and opinions put forward by representatives of the Italian State? Specifically, has the Italian State cited political expediency, budgetary constraints or a desire to curb spending in support of its stance? If this is indeed the case, to what extent (if at all) will the Commission take these arguments into account when assessing the compatibility with EU law of Italy’s regulations governing the economic, welfare and social rights of the tax judges concerned?
